title: Motor policy: flood damage
text: Flood damage to the insured vehicle is covered under the comprehensive motor policy. Engine damage caused by water entering the engine is covered only with the Engine Protect add-on.

title: Motor policy: claims intimation
text: Claims must be intimated within 48 hours of the incident through the app or the claims desk. A surveyor inspects the vehicle before repairs start.

title: Motor policy: no claim bonus
text: The no claim bonus starts at 20 percent after one claim-free year and rises to 50 percent after five claim-free years. Making a claim resets the no claim bonus.
